title: Exit settings are not range-checked: a typo silently disables the trailing stop, and some values tear down protection on a still-held position or sell at once

evidence.note: TRAILING_STOP_PCT / TRAILING_MIN_PCT / TRAILING_MAX_PCT = parseFloat(env || default) with no NaN guard

computeEffectiveTrailingPct: Math.max(min, Math.min(max, NaN)) is NaN, so triggerPrice at :1751 is NaN and currentPrice <= NaN is never true: the trailing stop never fires, and stop-loss is already off once trailing activated (:1781)
STOP_LOSS_PCT has a NaN guard only: 0 sells at the first tick at or below entry, a negative value sells at once, 100 or more never sells

EXIT_DUST_THRESHOLD_BPS has no upper bound: 10000 or more makes any balance up to the original amount read as dust, so a failed exit is torn down as a genuine close (anti-rug unsubscribed, exit_state deleted, timers cleared, :1143-1153)
EXIT_ROUTINE_MAX_FAILURES accepts 0 (n >= 0): routine retries pause after the first failure
PARTIAL_SELL_TARGETS accepts a multiple below 1 (for example 0.5x), which sells that tier at the first tick

sibling_sites_checked: Every env-derived exit number (thresholds/EXIT.json TH-EXIT rows). Guarded: MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS and the two slippage knobs (never NaN, never negative, slippage clamped to 99% at :492), PARTIAL_SELL_TARGETS total < 100 and positive entries (throws at load). Unguarded: the trailing trio, the stop-loss range, the dust bps upper bound, the routine-failure floor. CONFIG.slippagePercent is hard-coded 5, so `|| 5` (:470) cannot hide a 0 today.
severity_rationale: S2: misconfiguration-only (the defaults are sane), so bounded. The trailing NaN case is silent (no error at load) and leaves a 2x-plus position with only the 30-minute urgency exit; the dust case strips anti-rug from a still-held position after a failed exit.
recommendation: Validate every exit setting at load with explicit ranges and fail loud (stop-loss 0-100 exclusive, trailing min <= base <= max, dust bps well below 10000, routine failures >= 1, tier multiples > 1). Card EXIT-12 (it changes what the bot accepts at boot). Phase 24 for the capital ones.
